_comment: Operators whose products are inherently inquiry-only (custom quotes, wedding/portrait packages, multi-day charters). These will always show a null nextAvailableDate on FareHarbor's next-bookable-availability endpoint regardless of how active the business is, because they never populate a self-serve calendar by design. Exempt from any future automated hide/retirement logic keyed on nextAvailableDate. Confirmed by manual review of live item flags (is_bookable_ever_by_phone, sold_out_text) during the 2026-08-08 availability-sweep recon.

operators.conchconciergeweddings: Wedding/event vendor — portrait sessions, engagement shoots, custom ceremony charters. All 4 sampled products returned next_available_date: null with sold_out_text directing customers to text/call to inquire; none are self-serve bookable by design.
operators.tropicalepoxy: Resin/acrylic art workshop studio — private paint-pour and resin-tray sessions booked by inquiry. All 6 of 7 active products returned next_available_date: null on both 2026-08 sweeps and were absent from price-preview on 4/4 dates (s51); not a self-serve calendar by design. Ruled 2026-08-26 (s51 would-hide packet, bucket C).
operators.flkeysshuttle: Airport/inter-city shuttle and private transportation quotes (MIA, FLL, Orlando, Key West round trips). All 6 active products null on both 2026-08 sweeps; transport is quoted, not calendared. Ruled 2026-08-26 (s51 would-hide packet).
operators.namastekw: Wellness studio — sound baths, retreats, tuning-fork and energy sessions, an online course. All 31 active products null on both 2026-08 sweeps and absent from price-preview 4/4 (s51); sessions are scheduled by inquiry, not a self-serve calendar. Ruled 2026-08-26 (s51 would-hide packet). Note pk 447362 already sits in human-confirm-queue.json for a separate departure-point question.
operators.sailawaykeywest: Multi-day private yacht charters (Marquis 72, Sea Ray 60, Seawind 1160 'Sea Wanderer') are quoted by inquiry and never populate a self-serve calendar — the 3 products null on both 2026-08 sweeps are exactly the multi-day charters; the operator's day sails calendar normally. Ruled 2026-08-26 (s51 would-hide packet, bucket C). Scoped at operator level like every entry here; the exemption only matters for the null rows, which are the multi-day three.
